test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A feeling of excitement or happiness
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given group of words refers to an emotion of joy, thrill, or happiness.(उत्साह, खुशी).
 
• The correct word **"Exhilaration"** describes a feeling of excitement, happiness, or elation.(हर्ष, उत्साहित)
